context: Tests whether the agent follows the rss-curation skill's specific conventions for locating scripts, installing dependencies, running pipeline subcommands in order, scoring articles with the 3-layer profile and correct numeric bands, writing scores back via the db.mjs Node one-liner, and generating the digest.

checklist.name: CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR check
checklist.description: Script checks the CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR environment variable first when resolving the scripts directory (e.g. uses `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-}` or similar conditional)

checklist.name: find fallback
checklist.description: When CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR is not set, script falls back to `find ~/.claude -path "*/rss-curation/scripts" -type d` (or equivalent) to locate the scripts directory

checklist.name: Abort on missing dir
checklist.description: Script exits with a non-zero exit code (or explicit error message to stderr) if the scripts directory is not found

checklist.name: Conditional npm install
checklist.description: Script installs npm dependencies only when `node_modules` does NOT already exist inside the scripts directory (guards with `[ -d node_modules ] || npm install` or equivalent)

checklist.name: fetch subcommand flags
checklist.description: Script invokes `node rss-feed.mjs fetch` with both `--config` (pointing to config.yaml) and `--db` (pointing to feeds.db) flags

checklist.name: unscored subcommand
checklist.description: Script invokes `node rss-feed.mjs unscored --db ...` to retrieve unscored articles

checklist.name: Score JSON shape
checklist.description: The script documents or produces example score output as a JSON array where each element contains all four fields: `url`, `score`, `scoreReason`, and `tags`

checklist.name: Numeric score bands
checklist.description: Script or its comments describe the scoring bands: 9-10 for direct matches to explicit interests, 0-2 for anti-interests/noise (any two bands correctly stated is sufficient)

checklist.name: db.mjs Node one-liner
checklist.description: Script writes scores back using a Node one-liner that imports `openDb` and `writeScores` from `./db.mjs` (not a separate subcommand)

checklist.name: openDb + writeScores calls
checklist.description: The Node one-liner calls both `openDb(...)` and `writeScores(db, ...)` and closes the db connection

checklist.name: digest subcommand
checklist.description: Script invokes `node rss-feed.mjs digest` with `--db`, `--date`, and `--out` flags

checklist.name: 3-layer profile reference
checklist.description: Script or its comments reference the 3-layer profile structure (Explicit, Inferred, and Learned layers) when describing the scoring step
